The worst experience with @fabhotel ever for me. They give you worst rooms of you are booking online. The room had half lights working, broken corners.

The biggest issue was I had a week long stay with them. The mattress spring was completely broken with its hardness being felt from the hands. I requested them to change mattress or have a mattress on the floor, both were denied.

They will just accept your issues but won't do anything to address. Not really recommended from my angle as a hotel expects a good bed to sleep and polite service. I found both missing here
